name: Camera Lens Blur

name: Gaussian Blur

name: Fast Box Blur

name: Directional Blur
summary: Linear blur along an angle; simulated speed smear/trails.

name: CC Radial Blur
summary: Radial directional or zoom-streak blur based on a center; useful for impact effects.

name: CC Radial Fast Blur
summary: Faster radial-style effect; fewer/other controls than standard.

name: Radial Blur

name: CC Vector Blur
summary: Uses vectors/texture for stylized flow-like warping/blurring.

name: Compound Blur
summary: Uses a secondary layer's brightness to change blur amount across the image.

name: Channel Blur

name: Bilateral Blur
summary: Smooths regions while retaining prominent edges.

name: Smart Blur

name: Sharpen
summary: Basic edge enhancement; halos appear if overdone.

name: Unsharp Mask

name: Camera-Shake Deblur

name: CC Cross Blur

name: Blend

name: Set Matte

name: Shift Channels

name: Set Channels

name: Minimax

name: Remove Color Matting

name: Linear Color Key

name: Color Difference Key

name: Color Range

name: Difference Matte

name: Extract

name: Inner/Outer Key

name: CC Simple Wire Removal

name: Color Key
summary: Obsolete. Retained for compatibility; not mandatory in modern key workflow.

name: Lumetri Color

name: Curves

name: Exposure

name: Hue/Saturation

name: Black & White
summary: Tonal monochrome conversion with channel weights.

name: Brightness & Contrast
summary: Basic global correction; limited compared with Curves.

name: Vibrance
summary: Prioritize less-saturated color areas over skin tones in many cases.

name: Selective Color
summary: Fine color-group adjustment.

name: Channel Mixer
summary: Change RGB output from channel mixtures, make custom grayscale.

name: Leave Color
summary: Retain one selected hue while desaturating others.

name: Colorama
summary: Map luminance/phase to customizable color palette.

name: Color Link
summary: Match/link colors in layer-based workflows.

name: Color Stabilizer
summary: Correct fluctuating color using sample areas.

name: Equalize
summary: Redistribution of intensity histogram; stylized image contrast.

name: Photo Filter
summary: Warm/cool photographic filter color.

name: Shadow/Highlight
summary: Recover local dark/light detail; can flatten images.

name: Gamma/Pedestal/Gain

name: PS Arbitrary Map
summary: Photoshop arbitrary-map transfer function.

name: Apply Color LUT

name: Color Profile Converter
summary: Convert between color-profile spaces; distinct from simply applying a look LUT.

name: Mesh Warp
summary: Fine multi-cell deformation; more localized control.

name: Liquify
summary: Brush deformation/mesh for facial distortions, fire, organic visuals.

name: Displacement Map
summary: Another layer's brightness/color shifts pixels horizontally/vertically; depth-map illusion, water, ripples.

name: Transform
summary: Effect-order-aware extra transform; better than moving an entire layer when you need transform between effects.

name: Turbulent Displace
summary: Organic bubbling/wavy displacement; great for smoke, fire, animated drawn art.

name: Wave Warp
summary: Directional sine-wave fabric/hair/flag/river motion; Pinning controls where waves are suppressed.

name: Warp

name: CC Bend It
summary: Bend along points, fast for organic/tube bends.

name: CC Bender
summary: Bend based on bounding region with different behavior/controls.

name: CC Blobbylize
summary: Glossy melted/liquid-like blobby shapes; useful for fluid motion design.

name: CC Flo Motion
summary: Localized distortions around two control points.

name: CC Griddler
summary: Grid-based segmentation/deformation.

name: CC Lens
summary: Bulging/refracting lens distortion.

name: CC Page Turn
summary: Flip/curl page.

name: CC Power Pin
summary: Pin four corners of footage to a changing quadrilateral; screen replacement.

name: Corner Pin
summary: Four-corner pinning; simpler option, still valid, not universally obsolete.

name: CC Ripple Pulse
summary: Dynamic ripples that usually need animated Pulse/Amplitude values.

name: CC Slant
summary: Skew/slant geometry.

name: CC Tiler
summary: Copies a layer in tiles for infinite-space visual patterns.

name: Mirror
summary: Reflect content across adjustable line.

name: Offset
summary: Wrap image as it moves; seamless scrolling backgrounds.

name: Optics Compensation
summary: Fisheye / undistort lens geometry; Reverse Lens Distortion changes direction.

name: Polar Coordinates
summary: Rectangle↔polar map (tunnels/planet rings/clock-like effects).

name: Reshape
summary: Morph one drawn silhouette toward another using masks.

name: Ripple
summary: Water-surface-style waves.

name: Rolling Shutter Repair
summary: Correct skew/wobble artifacts from rolling-shutter cameras.

name: Twirl
summary: Twist pixels around center.

name: Warp Stabilizer
summary: Automatic image stabilization; separate from intentionally creative warp.

name: Detail-preserving Upscale
summary: More edge-aware scaling than simple magnification; evaluate fine details/halos.

name: 4-Color Gradient
summary: Four-point color interpolation, useful backgrounds.

name: Gradient Ramp

name: Grid

name: Lens Flare

name: Radio Waves
summary: Expanding rings/ripples; great for motion graphics.

name: Scribble

name: Stroke

name: Vegas

name: Write-on

name: Turbulent Noise

name: Noise

name: Dust & Scratches
summary: Remove small specks or produce painterly smoothing at high values.

name: Noise Alpha
summary: Randomize transparency.

name: CC Pixel Polly

name: Shatter

name: CC Mr. Mercury

name: Foam

name: CC Bubbles
summary: Floating/refractive bubbles sampling underlying image appearance.

name: CC Drizzle
summary: Droplet surface ripples.

name: CC Hair

name: CC Scatterize
summary: Scatter/fragment look.

name: CC Star Burst
summary: Starfield/travel visual.

name: Card Dance

name: Caustics

name: Wave World
summary: Generated simulated rippling water surfaces, usable as effect map.

name: Glow
summary: Bloom around bright areas; threshold/radius/intensity control.

name: Find Edges

name: CC Vignette
summary: Dark/light edge vignette.

name: Roughen Edges

name: Mosaic

name: Posterize

name: Strobe Light
